items.name: AI-HYSYS-Skill
items.description: AI-assisted Aspen HYSYS skill for existing-case parameter takeover, validation, and reporting.

items.name: HDA-Surrogate-Optimization
items.description: A Python-based interface for Aspen HYSYS enabling automated heat exchanger network (HEN) supertargeting to pre-identify the optimal ΔTmin.

items.name: Natural-Gas-Sweetening
items.description: Steady-state simulation of a natural gas sweetening unit using DEA solvent in Aspen HYSYS V14. Models full absorption-regeneration loop. >99.9% H₂S removal. Complete stream tables, column profiles, and energy analysis included.

items.name: CDU-Simulation-Optimization
items.description: Steady-state simulation of an Atmospheric Crude Distillation Unit (CDU) processing Arabian Light crude using Aspen HYSYS V14. Includes pump-around circuit design and a heat integration study achieving a 53.6% reduction in furnace duty through Pinch Analysis principles.

items.name: HYSYS-Python-Case-Builder
items.description: Python scripts for creating, opening, and modifying Aspen HYSYS case files through the COM interface.

items.name: rbf-interpolation-atmospheric-distillation
items.description: Radial Basis Function (RBF) interpolation framework for thermodynamically consistent data generation from Aspen HYSYS simulations of atmospheric distillation units processing multi-crude blends.

items.name: Pressure-Drop-Estimation-in-Pipelines
items.description: Pressure Drop Estimation in Pipelines using Darcy–Weisbach equation with analytical modeling and multi-software validation (MATLAB, Python, Excel, Aspen HYSYS & DWSIM).
